title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: provide first-class RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to reduce onboarding time for engineers evaluating Redwood for retrieval-augmented generation use-cases. This PR adds opinionated templates (retriever + agent loop), language-specific quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), updated docs site pages, and a small set of end-to-end smoke tests. Changes are intended to be non-breaking and additive.

What I changed: added a new `redwood-examples/rag-agents` folder containing templates and playbooks, added `docs/site` pages that document the templates and example deploy/run instructions, extended the TypeScript and Python SDK examples to show tool-calling with structured outputs and function-like tool interfaces, and added CI smoke tests to exercise the example flows in GitHub Actions.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add RAG agent templates and example configs
- [x] Add Python quickstart (example notebook + minimal app)
- [x] Add TypeScript quickstart (example server + client)
- [x] Add docs site pages and TOC entries
- [x] Add GitHub Actions smoke tests for examples
- [x] Update README and quickstart landing page

Testing notes: ran example smoke tests in CI (initial flaky run due to emulator auth; fixed by adding a short wait and improved env var checks). All unit docs linting and markdown link checks pass.

Related work: builds on design spec ENG-3412, references previous examples in redwood-examples PRs (see history), and follows the docs layout changes introduced in ENG-2987.

notes: This PR is intentionally additive and contains no API surface changes in core runtime — only examples and docs.
The smoke tests are lightweight and mock external stores when possible; they are intended to catch regressions in example run instructions, not to be exhaustive integration tests.
Follow-up: consider adding a dedicated CI matrix for the examples that runs against Dedicated in staging (tracked in ENG-3520).
